title: Aural Fields
summary: Masters thesis project and SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 submission — a real-time ray-traced spatial audio system that simulates sound propagation, occlusion, and material interaction for immersive and physically accurate audio experiences.
goal: Explore, conceptualize and implement a novel approach to spatial audio using ray tracing techniques. Perform experiments in different environments and accumulate data. Apply research-oriented procedures when compiling results and producing high-level reports and papers.

title: League of Legends: Fog of War
summary: A recreation of League of Legend's fog-of-war system built with Compute Shaders.
role: Solo Developer, System Architect, Graphics Programmer
goal: Reverse-engineer the staged visibility system behind a production MOBA and understand how texture masking interacts with gameplay state at scale.

title: GPU Instancing: Dynamic Mesh-Based Shadows
summary: A GPU-driven shadow system that renders dynamic mesh-based shadows overhead using GPU Instancing.
goal: Conceptualize and implement a highly-performant, visually stunning mesh-based shadow system using GPU instancing for the World Cricket Championship Mobile Game.

title: Scenari Foliage
summary: Wind animation, LOD-aware colour variation, and interaction bending — all procedurally driven without artist-authored animation curves.
goal: Build production-quality foliage rendering on par with commercial engines, mastering the vertex shader techniques that make foliage feel alive.
skills: Vertex Shaders;HLSL;Wind Simulation;Procedural Animation;Geometry Shaders;Fragment Shaders;Scriptable Objects;C#

title: Profit Pits
summary: A connected multiplayer mining game built for a university module on networked games — players coordinate in real time across shared underground environments.
role: Procedural Generation Developer, Shader Programmer, Gameplay Programmer, Researcher
goal: Build a functional and procedurally generated cave system that is both highly performant, customizable and organic looking. Build a shader that allows for viewing into the caves that can adapt to coalescing views between players.

title: WATERWAYS!
summary: Compute shader based procedural island generation with ray-traced shadows, water simulations and more.
goal: Understand the shader maths behind creating stunning 2D visuals using ray tracing, building real-time simulations for water wakes and organic island landmass colouring.

title: BOSSBORNE
summary: A soulslike boss-rush focused on hitbox precision, telegraphed attack patterns, and state-machine driven AI — studying what makes difficult combat feel fair.
role: Gameplay Programmer, Graphics Developer, Level Designer, Procedural Generation Designer, LLM Researcher & Boss Designer
goal: Create an LLM-powered companion that generates quests, items and spawns enemies procedurally. Develop a world system that regenerates and repopulates the environment daily. Design AI state machines that feel reactive without being random.
skills: LLM Integration;Shaders;Procedural Generation;FSM / State Machines;Hitbox Systems;Animation Events;Boss AI;C#

goal: Apply AI tooling outside game dev, sharpening skills in API integration, automated systems, async workflows, and web UI design.
